description: Family 3 (docs/tasks.md section 4). The pinned lock rule and channel forecast, unbounded server capital, a common volume denominator, and a server-tier term: the capital on the server's own Lightning channels, pre-funded by the same margin rule as an agent's channel and never rebalanced during the horizon (docs/server_tier_proposal.md, adopted 2026-10-02). Corner parameters marked given are those of the corner test in vendor/spiral/model/server.test.ts at the pinned commit; everything else is a bench decision.

provenance.many_bursty_long: given: corner('many-bursty') in model/server.test.ts (200 agents, 5000 sat in at p=0.02, 4000 sat out at p=0.01, horizon 8 lifetimes). Every agent accumulates: mean inflow 100 sat per step, mean outflow 40.
provenance.many_bursty_balanced: invented: the same bursts with inflow and outflow equal in rate and size, so no agent has net drift before the funded-spend rule
provenance.many_bursty_balanced_correlated: invented: the balanced cell with 80% of burst indicators copied from a population-wide draw
provenance.few_steady_recycling: given: corner('few-steady') in model/server.test.ts (3 agents, 100 + floor(10u) sat in and out every step, horizon 8 lifetimes)
provenance.always_channel_margin: given: margin 0.25 in the pinned corner test
provenance.always_vtxo_refresh_lead_blocks: given: refresh lead 288 in the pinned corner test and config/protocol.json (R5)
provenance.always_vtxo_margin: invented: the channel baseline's margin applied to the server's channels
